sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The ASL covers SP-700 for PLT-BEI/CUST-AUR only with SUP-F. There is no approval for Minuterie Germanasca (SUP-G). The SUP-G approvals are for other parts, and an approval for one part does not extend to another.

sources.quote:
The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
after any of: a change of source

findings.why: SP-700 is on PRG-Z, an Aurelia program. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual is in force and replaces revision 3. It requires written approval (PPAP) before shipping after a change of source, and also 90 days' notification. No existing approval or deviation covers this change.

sources.quote: A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for the drawing material. Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: SUP-G has 3.1 certificates only for DC04, C67S and 42CrMo4. There is none for PA66-GF30, the SP-700 drawing material. The SQE (E. Gallo) must answer. SUP-G also has no PA66-GF30 entry in the capability list.
